title: Symptom checker
summary: Describe your symptoms and get likely causes and next steps.
whyTempting: Everyone googles symptoms; doctors are expensive and slow.
whyItFails: Liability. Regulators and lawyers watch medical advice closely. Low trust. Users still want to see a doctor. No clear payer. Consumers won't pay; insurers are slow to buy.
whatWouldChange: Integration with telehealth so triage leads directly to care and payment.

attempts.notes: AI triage chatbot; claims of doctor-level diagnosis were disputed. Went public via SPAC in 2021, then liquidated in the US and entered administration in the UK in 2023.
Tech-first primary care, including self-serve AI CarePods.
